text:
```yaml
name: Format

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v2
    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rust-lang/rust-toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
    - name: Run cargo fmt check
      run: cargo fmt --all --check
```
